info.name: Oxi Word Previews
info.summary: Thumbnails of .docx files, drawn on your server without LibreOffice
info.description:
Nextcloud ships its Word-document previews switched off: they start LibreOffice once for every file. This app shows thumbnails of `.docx`, `.docm` and `.dotx` files in Files without LibreOffice, Collabora or ONLYOFFICE.
The thumbnails are drawn by the bundled [Oxi](https://github.com/Ryujiyasu/oxi) engine, a single Rust program that runs on the server itself. The document never leaves your server, and the app makes no network requests.
- Nothing to configure: enable the app and Word documents get thumbnails. - Bundled for Linux x86_64 and arm64 (static, so Alpine-based installs work too). - About 0.1 s for a typical document.
Oxi lays documents out to match Microsoft Word, and on documents scored against Word's own PDFs it is closer than LibreOffice. A thumbnail shows the first page as Oxi's PDF output would.
This app was written with AI assistance (Claude). It is not part of Nextcloud: report problems at the Oxi repository.
